headline: Kuwait Signs $16 Billion Pipeline Deal With Blackstone, KKR, Brookfield Despite Rising Regional Tensions
summary: KPC secures a $16B pipeline investment from Blackstone, KKR and Brookfield, marking Kuwait’s largest FDI deal amid growing Gulf security concerns.

headline: Kuwait signs $16 billion oil pipeline deal with Blackstone, KKR and Brookfield
summary: Investing.com -- Kuwait Petroleum Corporation has signed a $16 billion lease and leaseback agreement covering its crude oil pipeline network with Blackstone, KKR and Brookfield, Reuters reported.
